messages.author: d0b18666fe8582cb
messages.subject: S-X2 tables
parts:
Hi Phil,

I'm running the S-X2 item fit stats (code below) on a unidimensional graded response model and am a little unclear on the difference between the freq tables produced from calling S_X2.tables = TRUE. I'm getting observed and expected freq tables labeled "O.org", "E.org", "O", and "E". I'm not sure what the difference is between observed/expected ".org" tables vs tables labeled "O" and "E". I tried to find more info on this but had a hard time finding any guidance. Any wisdom on this when you have a chance would be super helpful.

Thanks!
Keri

itemfit.irt9.1sx <- itemfit(irt9, fit_stats = "S_X2", S_X2.tables = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: S-X2 tables
parts:
The E.org and O.org tables are the original table of counts prior to collapsing across categories/sum-scores. The O and E tables are post-collapsing, and are the ones used to compute the S-X2 statistics. 

Phil
